title: Unstoppable Rams superteam easily stopped by 49ers, drop to last in NFC West

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Unstoppable Rams superteam easily stopped by 49ers, drop to last in NFC West
sources.description: It’s just Week 1, but the Rams could not have looked much worse as the supposed favorites to unseat the Seahawks as Super Bowl champions.
